name: Disable Green Ethernet
description: Disables Green Ethernet and similar power-saving features on physical network adapters to improve latency consistency for gaming PCs, though it may slightly increase power usage.

description_i18n.en: Disables Green Ethernet and similar power-saving features on physical network adapters to improve latency consistency for gaming PCs, though it may slightly increase power usage.
description_i18n.de: Deaktiviert Green Ethernet und ähnliche Stromsparfunktionen auf physischen Netzwerkadaptern für konsistentere Latenz bei Gaming-PCs; dies kann den Energieverbrauch leicht erhöhen.
description_i18n.fr: Désactive Green Ethernet et les fonctions d'économie d'énergie similaires sur les adaptateurs réseau physiques pour améliorer la stabilité de latence, ce qui peut légèrement augmenter la consommation électrique.

warnings.title: Power usage increase
warnings.message: Disabling power-saving features may slightly increase adapter power consumption and heat output during idle periods

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Uses Get-NetAdapterAdvancedProperty and Set-NetAdapterAdvancedProperty to detect registry keywords like EEE or Green Ethernet on physical network adapters The tweak sets matching properties to disabled using registry value 0 or the Disabled display value
